# Third-party assets

Assets bought under a license that allows using them in the game but not redistributing their files (the Unity
Asset Store's, which is also what Humble Bundle's Unity bundles come with). Everything in this folder except this
README is ignored by git: copy the files here by hand on each machine. Screenshots and videos of the game made with
them are fine to publish; the files themselves never leave this folder (no commit, no Patreon build of the sources).

Keep one folder per pack, named after it, and list it below with where it comes from.

| Folder | Pack | Source | Used for |
|---|---|---|---|
| | | | |

Models are converted for Gram by hand for now: open the `.fbx` in Blender (File → Import → FBX), then
File → Export → Wavefront (.obj) with *Triangulate Faces* checked. Static meshes only; animations will need glTF.
